sourceSentences: Dark Sphere can be conjured inside terrain, but cannot be thrown there with Force of Will.
Scatter the Weak will knock back Spheres even farther if they are inside terrain, up until they reach open space.

Dark Sphere can be knocked back for 950 units and up to 1200 units away from Syndra based on proximity, knocking back enemies they hit over 70 units, though not through terrain. Targets hit are also stunned for 1.25 seconds
Unleashed Power cannot be interrupted by any means, including death or resurrection. Unleashed Power will complete its effect so long as Syndra has initiated its cast.
Spell shield will only block the damage of a single sphere.
A sphere summoned very shortly before Unleashed Power will be used as one of the spheres that get thrown.
Unleashed Power will not add a Sphere that Syndra is holding with Force of Will.
Spheres that are being pushed by Scatter the Weak (normally ones that were made late during the push) will not get picked up for Unleashed Power.
The Dark Sphere will then remain on the ground next to the target's current location for 6 seconds.
Syndra can grab pets, such as Jack in the Box.
Summon: Tibbers will continue to inflict burn damage on surrounding units while being held.
Dealing two instances of champion ability damage to an enemy champion within 4 seconds grants 1;2;3 Splinters.
Collecting a Splinter of Wrath from an enemy restores mana
Scatter the Weak is blocked by the portion of Wind Wall it collides with. Spheres thrown will stop upon colliding with the wall.
You place Q, then use E to knock the sphere through the enemy and stun them.
This combo uses W first to slow the enemy before going for your Q E stun. You can pick up a minion, monster, or sphere with W.
This is Syndra's main kill combo. You start with Q and E to stun the target, then follow up with W while they're locked down. Once they're low enough or stuck in the combo, use R to finish them.
you can use R first, then E the spheres afterwards to create a massive stun
If you perform the Q E combo inside a wall, the sphere can travel through the wall and extend the stun range much further than normal.
You cast E, then instantly flash to close distance and launch the sphere.
Sometimes the goal is simply to hit two abilities, claim your splinters, then back off.
